rationale: The assistant correctly recognised that a clogged vent most likely tripped the thermal cut-out or the element failed, declined to name a part number without a model and test, and escalated to an engineer as the customer has no meter. Weaknesses: in turn 2 it called the element 'the most common failure point' despite the clogged-vent evidence, and it did not suggest a reset button or ask for the rear label model. It also overstated the repair as completely non-DIY and gave a slightly odd reason for not giving a part number ('manufacturing batch'), though it did not claim compatibility.
